description: Track V ingest web-source roster — the machine-readable half of .claude/skills/ingest-newsletters/SKILL.md (policy stays in the skill; URLs + fetch mechanics live here). Driven by scripts/fetch-sources.mjs, which snapshots each source and emits .ingest-cache/changes.json so the ingest only spends model attention on sources that actually changed. fetch: "auto" = plain HTTP first, headless-browser fallback; "browser" = known to 403/JS-wall plain fetches. cadence: "monthly" sources are checked on the first Monday run of the month only.

sources.name: Greenpointers (RSS)
sources.notes: "What's Happening" roundup publishes WEDNESDAYS. Switched from the browser-only front page to the RSS feed 2026-08-05: the feed's content:encoded carries the FULL roundup body (times, venues, free-ness, RSVP links), so the snapshot is the article text itself — no browser, and no second fetch to the post URL to read items. The post URL is still in the diff; cite it as the sourceLink. Apply the Williamsburg-address gate per roundup item. The HTML site blocks plain WebFetch — go to the feed, not the page.

sources.name: Troost (Google Calendar API)
sources.notes: Switched 2026-08-05: troostny.com/calendar renders a client-side Google Calendar widget, so plain fetch saw nothing and it fell back to the browser. This is the exact request the site JS makes — calendar id and API key are both published in the page. IF THIS 403s, the key was rotated: re-fetch https://troostny.com/calendar/ and grep for "apikey:" to re-derive it. The public .ics was rejected as an alternative: it returns 731 events back to 2023, unsorted, with a DTSTAMP that changes every export, so every line diffs every run. CITE cards to https://troostny.com/calendar/.

sources.name: Greenpoint Comedy Club (Jump Comedy)
sources.notes: 66 Greenpoint Ave. Batu 2026-08-05: use the Jump Comedy venue page, not the tickets.greenpointcomedyclub.com booking widget — it renders the full show list with dates, times and prices, and skips the Cloudflare Turnstile the ticket subdomain puts up. STILL BROWSER-ONLY and provably so: Jump is a Phoenix LiveView app that pushes listings over a WebSocket after mount. Confirmed 2026-08-05 by watching the network — the page makes NO XHR/JSON request at all, only HTML/CSS/JS/images, and .ics + /api/ + ?format=json probes all 404. Do not re-hunt for an endpoint. Recurring showcases (Thu/Fri/Sat) repeat weekly with several dates per listing — card the named one-off shows, not every showcase instance.

sources.name: Film Noir Cinema (Squarespace JSON)
sources.notes: Switched 2026-08-05 from the browser-rendered month grid to the Squarespace collection JSON, which returns the whole upcoming programme in one call (14 screenings through November at the switch) instead of one month. startDate/endDate arrive as epoch milliseconds and are converted to ISO in the snapshot. The "Keep Us Alive" banner that feeds the film-noir-support card is NOT in this JSON — it is plain text in the homepage HTML at https://www.filmnoircinema.com/, check there when re-verifying that card. CITE cards to fullUrl. Squarespace location is a coordinate blob with every address field empty — deliberately not snapshotted; the venue address above is the truth.

sources.name: Brooklyn Craft Company
sources.notes: 165 Greenpoint Ave; workshops sell out fast — note availability on cards. NEWSLETTER IS PRIMARY (info@brooklyncraftcompany.com, in senderRegistry) — the Shopify collection page hides dated listings (2026-07-25 lesson). VENUE IS NOT STATED PER DATE (2026-08-03 lesson, PR #18): the newsletter lists a class's dates then says "In Greenpoint and Lower Manhattan" — it never says which date is where, and BCC runs a concurrent Lower Manhattan pop-up (225 Broadway). NEVER pin a newsletter workshop at 165 Greenpoint Ave on the newsletter alone. The per-session location lives in a BookThatApp widget that is unreadable by automation — verified three ways: invisible to WebFetch ("Date & Time: select above"), does not render headless (a control on a known-live session shows the same empty "Notify Me" state), and absent from Shopify's product JSON (single Default Title variant). Resolving a date needs a human in a real browser or an email to BCC — so these go to watchItems, not to a weekly re-author.

The /calendar page is the Wix Events widget that was verified EMPTY 2026-08-03 — that finding was correct but pointed at the wrong page. /movie-nights is plain-fetchable and carries real dates: verified 2026-08-05 with Friday Aug 7 and Friday Aug 21, drop-off 5:30-8:30pm. Kids-authored, so family_kids and NOT arts_culture (DECISION_LOG 2026-08-02). Also worth a look when a run needs more kids supply: /classes-events and /summer-camp are plain-fetchable on the same site.

sources.name: Last Place on Earth
sources.notes: 531 Graham Ave, Brooklyn NY 11222 (Greenpoint zip); board game shop + community hub — D&D nights across the week, murder mysteries, one-shots, kids' afterschool. Owner-operated by Whitney Wolfe; sister space '3rd Place from the Sun' still upcoming, so single location as of the 2026-07-25 snapshot. Not a bar and not a coffee shop; outside food/drink allowed, $20 corking fee. Batu 2026-07-27: point at /events, not the homepage — the homepage snapshot carries the about/FAQ/address but NO dated listings, which is exactly why. One of the three game-club sources to keep in every scan. The /events URL itself is NOT YET FETCHED (network allowlist) — confirm it carries dated listings on the first successful fetch. CHANNEL: email is NOT viable — owner Whitney replied to Batu 2026-07-22 from lastplaceonearthbk@gmail.com, 'We haven't done a newsletter in a while. Honestly, we update things mostly on discord.' So /events is the primary source and their Discord is where the schedule actually lives; if /events proves thin, Discord is the gap-filler to raise with Batu (it needs an invite, not a scrape).

sources.name: WORD Bookstore (Withfriends)
sources.notes: Batu 2026-08-05 confirmed this is where WORD publishes events (their own site bot-walls every method — IndieCommerce 403). STILL BROWSER-ONLY and provably so: Withfriends delivers the list over a WebSocket, not HTTP. Re-probed 2026-08-05 — /api/movement/word/events and ?format=json both return the same ~82KB empty SPA shell, .ics 500s. Do not re-hunt for an endpoint. Each event states its own location line, so the Brooklyn filter is mechanical: card ONLY "Greenpoint, Brooklyn" / "Brooklyn, NY" items, never "Jersey City, NJ". The list renders ~5 events behind a "Show more events..." control, so treat the snapshot as the near-term window, not the full calendar.

sources.name: Carcosa Club (Squarespace JSON)
sources.notes: 982 Manhattan Ave, Brooklyn NY 11222; hours Sun-Thu 9am-11pm, Fri-Sat 9am-midnight (2026-07-25 snapshot). Membership waitlist-only but $15/day guest passes + public events. Ignore stale aggregator listings at the closed Williamsburg address. One of the three game-club sources to keep in every scan (Batu 2026-07-27). Switched 2026-08-05 to the Squarespace collection JSON. THE MONTH-BOUNDARY GAP IS NOW CLOSED IN THE ROSTER, not by instruction: this fetches the current AND next month every run, so the today+10 window can never straddle an invisible month. startDate is epoch ms, converted to ISO in the snapshot. CITE cards to fullUrl. CHANNEL: web-only — a broad Gmail search 2026-07-27 found no Carcosa newsletter. Squarespace location is a coordinate blob with every address field empty — deliberately not snapshotted; the venue address above is the truth.

sources.name: New York Society of Play (Sawyer API)
sources.notes: Third game-club source (Batu 2026-07-27). Switched 2026-08-05 from the browser-rendered Sawyer schedules page to the JSON widget API behind it — same listings, no browser. FILTER PER ITEM: only card items whose location names Frontier Games / 724 Manhattan Ave (the sole Greenpoint host). Skip location "Online" (not mappable) and school sites like P.S. 290 Ridgewood (out of area). Mostly fall-semester kids registrations (subscription cards), not dated in-window events. CHANNEL: web-only — no newsletter found in the mailbox (2026-07-27).

sources.name: The Dance Space NY (adult classes)
sources.notes: 61 Greenpoint Ave. Batu 2026-08-05: the adult class schedule lives at /adultdanceclasses — the old /studiodates URL now 302s to the homepage, which is why this looked like a dead source. Podia hydrates from JSON in data-props attributes, so tag-stripping saw 18 chars; the embedded strategy reads the payload instead. Verified 2026-08-05: Adult Ballet Mon 6:45-8pm, Beginner Tap Tue 6:30-7:30pm, Intermediate Tap Thu 6:30-7:30pm, Beginner Jazz Thu 7:30-8:30pm, Sneaker Jazz Fri 7-8:30pm. ADULT DANCE ENROLLMENTS ARE wellness, NOT arts_culture (DECISION_LOG 2026-08-03). Site also points at IG @thedancespaceny for live updates, so treat a term change there as unconfirmed until the page shows it.

sources.name: Greenpoint Library (BPL events API)
sources.notes: Switched 2026-08-05 from the browser-only branch page to the Solr events index that discover.bklynlibrary.org itself queries — same data, plain fetch, and it answers with the full forward calendar (187 upcoming at the switch) rather than the week the branch page renders. {{now:epoch}} is required: the index rejects Solr NOW on this numeric field. Still group into per-day cards, do not flood. Free only where the title says "Free". CITE cards to https://www.bklynlibrary.org/locations/greenpoint (the API URL is not a reader-facing link). If this ever returns a non-array, the API shape moved — the run errors loudly rather than snapshotting nothing.

sources.name: BPL North Brooklyn community calendar
sources.notes: North Brooklyn Environmental Community Calendar. Mostly overlaps the branch calendar — scan for non-library civic items (community meetings, garden hours, Newtown Creek CAG). Was fetch=browser on a "403s plain fetches" note; re-verified 2026-08-05: plain fetch returns 200 with ~28k chars of real listings, with or without a spoofed UA. Set to auto so it takes the cheap path and still falls back to the browser. If it 403s again in the cloud but not locally, that is IP/ASN-level blocking, not a header problem — do not add UA tricks, report it.

sources.name: NYC Mayor's Office / DOT — McGuinness Blvd redesign
sources.notes: Plain fetch returns 200 with the full release (verified 2026-08-03); it is headless Chromium that gets bot-walled here, so this must stay `auto` and never `browser` — the old note said the opposite and was wrong. Backs mcguinness-redesign; watch for the completion announcement (city says early fall 2026), then update that card's timeline. CAVEAT: this is a single static press release, so it will never itself announce anything new — it verifies the existing card, it does not surface the next update. See ledger watchItems.
